dataset.title: Sopot restaurant activity
dataset.disclosure: Independent seeded synthetic presentation data. No private transaction totals, weights, records, or performance results are used in this browser payload.

reasons.hourly: Purchase-date / GMT-time semantics are unverified. Daily reported-date forecasts only.
reasons.polygons: No verified postal-area polygons are supplied. Markers are approximate postcode points.
reasons.spatialSurface: Cell surfaces require verified polygons. Point coordinates do not establish areas or adjacency.
reasons.segments: Reliable, permitted residence classifications are unavailable. No resident/tourist inference.
reasons.coverage: Real analysis uses an explicit stable-reporting assumption; no complete-market demand claim.
reasons.privacy: Independent-entity support and jury/forecast release are not certified. Browser data is synthetic only.

provenance.geometrySource: GeoNames approximate postcode points, restricted to the Poczta Polska Sopot reference; public geographic context only.
modelNotes: All displayed activity and backtest metrics are from the independent synthetic scenario.
Next-reported-day forecasting; GMT/purchase-date semantics do not support a verified hourly replay.
The model sees only dates ending before the simulated 24-hour availability cutoff.
One pooled city model with shrunk postcode shares and count-linked Gamma value; seasonal baselines may win.
Predictive intervals are approximate. Measured coverage is shown, not guaranteed calibration.
No future weather, retrospective event listings, actual future totals, or residence data are forecast features.
Markers locate approximate postcode reference points, not restaurants or transaction positions.

evaluation.selectionReason: Pooled NB improved development count WAPE and passed value WAPE and city count MAE guardrails.
warnings: Synthetic backtest results demonstrate the workflow; they are not evidence of real-world forecast accuracy.
Selection is frozen on development results. May–June is held out; later causal refits use only matured earlier dates.
Intervals measure predictive uncertainty for postcode totals, not the accuracy of point locations or any within-area allocation.
No validated hourly, customer-flow, resident/tourist, or subpostcode model is enabled.
